entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I hope you can help. I need to return my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with it. I can certainly look into the return options. First, to make sure I'm following the correct procedure, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's... I guess it's a preference? It just feels so confusing. The user manual wasn't much help, and the whole interface is just so hard to use. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really expected more.
I understand completely. It's frustrating when a new gadget doesn't click right away. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. Can I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF8675309. I feel awful about this. I saved up for it, and I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out for me.
I have your order right here. Thank you. I see it was delivered 17 days ago. Let me just check the eligibility.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that timeframe. I can approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That easily? Oh, thank you so much, Charlie. That's a huge weight off my shoulders. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

It's no problem at all. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
That's wonderful. Thank you again for being so helpful.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've made my day! Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a Happy New Year.
